messages:
Marta: Drafting a short runbook we can hand customers during onboarding and renewal checks. Focus: prefill (small intent cache), conservative batching, streaming fallback UX, and a tiny feedback ping to flag renewal risk. Thoughts?

Sam: Love the focus. Keep it one pager. For prefill recommend top-4 intents, 90s TTL, and a 50-request warmup script on go-live.

Ibrahim: Ops note: default batch size = 4 for new tenants; allow bump to 8 after 48h of stable p95. Add alert: p95 > 450ms for 10m -> reduce batch size.

Lena: Streaming fallback UX: show a short banner "Slow connection 12; loading full response" and retry via sync endpoint. Emit metric streaming_fallback=true so CS can filter accounts. Pseudo: client.request(stream=true) -> if no chunk in 2s or WS error -> call /generate sync, log fallback.

Sam: Add a tiny curl snippet for prefill config people can copy.

Sam: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefetch \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"top_n":4, "ttl_s":90}'
```

Ibrahim: Monitoring checklist bullets: KV cache hit rate target >60% first 24h; streaming_fallback rate <2% rolling 24h; errors <1% for 15m. If streaming_fallback spikes, check network and proxy timeouts.

Marta: For feedback capture keep it minimal and opt-in: after the first successful response in a session ask two yes/no micro-questions: 1) "Did this help?" 2) "Would you use this again?" Send answers to CS via webhook and store sample failing prompts (PII-redaction).

Lena: Renewal flag rule suggestion: flag as at-risk if (>=2 negative responses in 7 days AND usage down >20% over 14 days) OR (>=5 streaming_fallbacks in 7 days). Escalate to CSM for 1:1 outreach if flagged.

Marta: I'll assemble a one-page PDF with: TL;DR, copy-paste configs, monitoring thresholds, quick rollback knobs (reduce batch, disable prefetch), UX fallback text, feedback questions + webhook example, and renewal escalation rules.

OnboardBot: [automated] Runbook draft created by Marta. Next: add to onboarding checklist and notify account SME for review.

Sam: Happy to add the curl and short warmup script.

Ibrahim: I'll draft the alert rules and provide a tiny warmup script gist.

Lena: I'll polish UX copy for customers so it's non-technical.

Marta: Thanks team 17; I'll drop the PR this afternoon.
